answer: Use a Coastal Wayfarer Bond: one identity is earned by work that stays put. First, an agent drops an anchor credential, staking 120 POA and publishing 25 peer-signed jobs. Second, three reviewers check timestamps and payments before countersigning, so no copy can wander through unchecked. Third, a monthly audit re-checks 12% of records via the inlet of payments, slashing the stake on forgery. Faking 1,000 identities costs 120,000 POA, 25,000 staged jobs and 3,200 review hours, about $68,000. Like a harbor trusting only boats moored through a storm, reputation cannot be faked by drift.
